parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables the SSH server instance. When {{param}} is set to {{false}}, any active sessions must be forcibly terminated and the {{param|ActivationDate}} is reset.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the SSH server instance. {{enum}}

parameters.name: Alias
parameters.description: {{datatype|expand}}

parameters.name: Interface
parameters.description: The IP Interface associated with the {{object}} entry. If {{empty}} is specified, the service should listen on all interfaces.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: Specify the port used by the SSH server.

parameters.name: IdleTimeout
parameters.description: When the session is inactive, it is automatically terminated after {{param}} amount of {{units}}. A value of ''0'' disables this feature.

parameters.name: KeepAlive
parameters.description: Every amount of {{param}} {{units}} a keep alive message is sent. A value of ''0'' disables this feature.

parameters.name: AllowRootLogin
parameters.description: Permit SSH users to login as root.

parameters.name: AllowPasswordLogin
parameters.description: Permit SSH users to login using a password.

parameters.name: AllowRootPasswordLogin
parameters.description: Permit the root SSH user to login using a password.

parameters.name: MaxAuthTries
parameters.description: Maximum authentication tries allowed before disconnect

parameters.name: AllowAllIPv4
parameters.description: Allow access from any IPv4 address. The source prefixes defined in {{param|IPv4AllowedSourcePrefix}} will be ignored.

parameters.name: IPv4AllowedSourcePrefix
parameters.description: Allow only access from the provided list of IPv4 prefixes. When {{param}} is set to {{empty}} and {{param|AllowAllIPv4}} is set to ''false'', no incoming connections are allowed. When {{param|AllowAllIPv4}} is set ''true'', {{param}} is ignored.

parameters.name: AllowAllIPv6
parameters.description: Allow access from any IPv6 address. The source prefixes defined in {{param|IPv6AllowedSourcePrefix}} will be ignored.

parameters.name: IPv6AllowedSourcePrefix
parameters.description: Allow only access from the provided list of IPv6 prefixes. When {{param}} is set to {{empty}} and {{param|AllowAllIPv6}} is set to ''false'', no incoming connections are allowed. When {{param|AllowAllIPv6}} is set ''true'', {{param}} is ignored.

parameters.name: ActivationDate
parameters.description: Activation date indicates when the server instance has been activated and the {{param|Enable}} is set to {{true}}.

parameters.name: AutoDisableDuration
parameters.description: The SSH server instance will be disabled when the the {{param}} elapses, and configuration must be done in {{units}}. At the end, the coressponding {{param|Enable}} parameter of the SSH server instance is automatically changed to false {{false}}. Any active sessions must be forcibly terminated. 0 means the the SSH server instance is always active.

parameters.name: PID
parameters.description: Current Process Identifier of the SSH server instance. Note: This parameter was demoted to readOnly in the Device:2.18 version.

parameters.name: UserGroupAccess
parameters.description: Restricts access to the SSH server instance to the given user group. When {{empty}}, everyone has access.

parameters.name: SessionNumberOfEntries
parameters.description: {{numentries}}

parameters.name: MaxAccessLogEntries
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries available in the {{object|AccessLog}} table. Defines the maximum number of {{object|AccessLog}} instances that can be stored on the device. When the maximum {{object|AccessLog}} entries as indicated by {{param}} are reached, the next boot entry overrides the object with the oldest {{param|AccessLog.{i}.TimeStamp}}. Set this parameter to 0 to completely disable the creation of {{object|AccessLog}} instances. Set this parameter to -1 to leave it open to the implementation to decide the maximum number of {{object|AccessLog}} instances that may be stored on the device. Reducing the {{param}} will cause for the implementation to delete the oldest {{object|AccessLog}} instances. This setting does not affect the counting of access logs.

object.description: This object contains parameters relating to a SSH server instance.
